en: The image shows a historical town square with a prominent central building that features a tall clock tower and ornate architectural details. The square is surrounded by other period buildings, and there are a few people walking or standing around. The central building is likely the town hall (Rathaus). The image is in sepia tones, giving it an old-fashioned look. The upper part of the postcard contains German text in red: 'Kamenz i. Sa.' and 'Markt u. Rathaus.'
